title: Latent Transforming Growth Factor β Binding Protein 3 Controls Adipogenesis
authors: Karan Singh; Nalani Sachan; Taylor Ene; Branka Dabovic; Daniel Rifkin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究LTBP3在脂肪生成中的TGFβ依赖性功能，属于细胞分化与信号通路研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Transforming growth factor-beta (TGFβ) is released from cells as part of a trimeric latent complex consisting of TGFβ, the TGFβ propeptides, and either a latent TGFβ binding protein (LTBP) or glycoprotein-A repetitions predominant (GARP) protein. LTBP1 and 3 modulate latent TGFβ function with respect to secretion, matrix localization, and activation and, therefore, are vital for the proper function of the cytokine in a number of tissues. TGFβ modulates stem cell differentiation into adipocytes (adipogenesis), but the potential role of LTBPs in this process has not been studied. We observed that 72 h post adipogenesis initiation Ltbp1 , 2 , and 4 expression levels decrease by 74-84%, whereas Ltbp3 expression levels remain constant during adipogenesis. We found that LTBP3 silencing in C3H/10T1/2 cells reduced adipogenesis, as measured by the percentage of cells with lipid vesicles and the expression of the transcription factor peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ). Lentiviral mediated expression of an Ltbp3 mRNA resistant to siRNA targeting rescued the phenotype, validating siRNA specificity. Knockdown (KD) of Ltbp3 expression in 3T3-L1, M2, and primary bone marrow stromal cells (BMSC) indicated a similar requirement for Ltbp3 . Epididymal and inguinal white adipose tissue fat pad weights of Ltbp3 -/- mice were reduced by 62% and 57%, respectively, compared to wild-type mice. Inhibition of adipogenic differentiation upon LTBP3 loss is mediated by TGFβ, as TGFβ neutralizing antibody and TGFβ receptor I kinase blockade rescue the LTBP3 KD phenotype. These results indicate that LTBP3 has a TGFβ-dependent function in adipogenesis both in vitro and in vivo. Significance Understanding the control of mesenchymal stem cell fate is crucial for the potential use of these cells for regenerative medicine. Highlights Latent TGFβ binding protein 3 (LTBP3) is required for adipogenesis LTBP3 mediates TGFβ levels in adipogenesis Loss of LTBP3 results in enhanced rather than decreased levels of active TGFβ
abstract_zh: 转化生长因子-β（TGFβ）以三聚体潜伏复合物形式从细胞释放，该复合物由TGFβ、TGFβ前肽以及潜伏TGFβ结合蛋白（LTBP）或糖蛋白A重复优势（GARP）蛋白组成。LTBP1和3在分泌、基质定位和激活方面调节潜伏TGFβ功能，因此对细胞因子在多种组织中的正常功能至关重要。TGFβ调节干细胞向脂肪细胞的分化（脂肪生成），但LTBPs在此过程中的潜在作用尚未被研究。我们观察到，在脂肪生成启动后72小时，Ltbp1、2和4的表达水平下降74-84%，而Ltbp3的表达水平在脂肪生成过程中保持恒定。我们发现，在C3H/10T1/2细胞中沉默LTBP3可减少脂肪生成，通过含脂质囊泡的细胞百分比和转录因子过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARγ）的表达来衡量。慢病毒介导的、对靶向siRNA具有抗性的Ltbp3 mRNA表达可挽救该表型，验证了siRNA的特异性。在3T3-L1、M2和原代骨髓基质细胞（BMSC）中敲低（KD）Ltbp3表达表明对Ltbp3有类似需求。与野生型小鼠相比，Ltbp3-/-小鼠附睾和腹股沟白色脂肪组织的脂肪垫重量分别减少了62%和57%。LTBP3缺失时脂肪生成分化的抑制由TGFβ介导，因为TGFβ中和抗体和TGFβ受体I激酶阻断可挽救LTBP3 KD表型。这些结果表明，LTBP3在体外和体内脂肪生成中具有TGFβ依赖性功能。意义：理解间充质干细胞命运的控制对于这些细胞在再生医学中的潜在应用至关重要。亮点：潜伏TGFβ结合蛋白3（LTBP3）是脂肪生成所必需的；LTBP3在脂肪生成中介导TGFβ水平；LTBP3缺失导致活性TGFβ水平增强而非降低。
